reports.notes: Handwritten. Six cells (line 1 both columns, line 2 both columns, lines 4 and 6) are the filer's slashed-zero glyph, transcribed '0'. FILER INCONSISTENCY RETAINED: line 2 Column B (Year-to-Date expenditures) is written as zero here even though the same filer's 10/22/10 report printed 2,549.71 year-to-date - transcribed as printed, not reconciled. Line 3 is partially overlapped by the pre-printed 'Refer to Line 7 on your last report' arrow graphic, which covers the final digit; read as -1,549.71 at medium confidence (lines 5 and 7 print the same figure fully legibly). Lines 5 and 7 carry a hand-written '$' before the minus sign; the '$' is dropped per spec. Cover form is the un-year-stamped 2-5-2 version, unlike the other 2010 filings in this chunk. Office field reads 'ASSESSOR' in all caps.
